name: Love Lime!
source:
You play as Lime, a human-turned-fruit who struggles to find a way to turn back into a human while attending a fruit school with their best friend, Durian. Along the way, Lime meets some eccentric but fun fruit students who they may or may not pursue romantically.

[From [url=https://dreamteam.itch.io/love-lime]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你將扮演青檸，一個變成了水果的人。青檸一邊與最好的朋友榴蓮在水果學校上學，一邊苦苦尋找變回人類的辦法。一路上，青檸會結識幾個個性古怪又有趣的水果同學，至於要不要和他們談戀愛，就不一定了。

［摘自[url=https://dreamteam.itch.io/love-lime]Itch.io[/url]］
